title: 1.3 What they do
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
goal: Say what two people do with they/we and no -s (They swim.), against he/she with -s (Ana swims.) and A1's They are swimming.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.3 Two People: They and Are: They are swimming. becomes They swim. The one new grammar relationship is they/we + verb without -s, taught as the contrast They swim. / Ana swims. after 1.2's he/she -s.
prerequisite: A1 1.3 and, they, are, swimming, running; 1.9 Who…?; 2.1 park; 3.2 we; 4.5 in the morning; 4.8 run; A1+ 1.2 he/she -s; A1+ 1.1 the cast.
speaking_outcome: A clear final s in swims and runs (/z/) inside the complete sentence, and no s after they, we or a pair of names. Do not require native-like speed.
